identity.name: load_zoning
identity.description: Loads Toronto's Zoning By-law 569-2013 from ten CKAN DataStore resources (one package) into ten tables: the base zone layer zoning_bylaw_areas and nine overlays. One package_show decides the run (skip only when every layer is unchanged, R2-12); each layer is paged through datastore_search, shaped, deduplicated (reject-all), geometry-validated and written by a guarded upsert on source_id plus an F-C1-guarded departure delete, one transaction per layer. The base layer is required (its failure aborts the step, D3); an overlay failure is a WARN and the run continues.

why_lock.text: Mutual exclusion with every other writer of the ten zoning tables (Spec 47 §A.5 row 58, DEC-A: lock = spec number); the shell keeps `const ADVISORY_LOCK_ID = 58;` as a §5.4 source-text constant, asserted equal by the pipeline advisory-lock suite.

batch_why.text: MQ-B1 (a), registry-truth fold 19: ten write targets, and the ingest writer strides EACH by pipeline.maxRowsPerInsert(columnsPerRow) (scripts/lib/step/write.js executeWrite): zoning_bylaw_areas 27 columns -> 2427 rows, zoning_height_overlay 7 -> 9362, zoning_lot_coverage_overlay 5 -> 13107, zoning_building_setback_overlay 8 -> 8191, zoning_policy_area_overlay 7 -> 9362, zoning_policy_road_overlay 5 -> 13107, zoning_rooming_house_overlay 8 -> 8191, zoning_parking_zone_overlay 6 -> 10922, zoning_priority_retail_overlay 9 -> 7281, zoning_queenstw_eat_overlay 8 -> 8191. One number cannot state ten strides, so batch is "none" (generated by scripts/generate-ingest-batch.js); no ingest runner reads execution.batch.

on_row_error_why.text: A record with a null geometry, a non-integer _id, a duplicated _id (reject-all, R2-17) or a geometry the validator cannot use is counted and the layer continues [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:430-478]; each skip is a named counter in the row-conservation identity and an audit row; the base tolerance is bounded by the FAIL-severity zoning_areas_invalid_polygon_pct / zoning_areas_invalid_polygon_count band.

on_check_error_why.text: Every check reads a value the library already measured, so a check that throws is a library or compute defect, not an upstream condition — it must redden the run rather than drop its row.

why.text: The legacy INFO row `dataset_source_license` = the Toronto Open Data licence URL, on every run including a skip [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:588]. Read from the declared externals (all ten carry the same licence); a missing licence reads 1.

Legacy WARN row pushed only when ZONING_FORCE_RELOAD=1 (the additive ① force seam, 15d69d04, plan O2) [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:589]; now always present, WARN exactly when override.force_run stands, so a forced reload says so on its own record and the forced PRE and POST captures carry the same row.

expect.reports: true when the all-layers gate skipped the run (R2-12), false on a load

why.text: The legacy INFO row `no_op_refresh: true` on an all-layers skip [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:616]; now present on every run (false on a load), read from records_meta.gate (gated_skip).

expect.violation_when: a required base field (_id, geometry or a mapped CKAN column) is missing from the first raw record

order_guarantee.guarantee: A missing required base field must abort the step before the base write and before any overlay is acquired (D3).

why.text: F-H3 + D3 [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:412-422, :681-682]: a missing REQUIRED base field aborts the step before the base write (and so before any overlay). LZ-D3: the drift is read from the first raw record only (acquired.record_fields, 0y). value = {missing, extra}; extra columns alone never abort (zoning_attr_drift_extra_columns).

expect.violation_when: the base layer would load zero rows

order_guarantee.guarantee: An empty base layer must FAIL before any overlay is loaded (OB-2, D3).

why.text: OB-2 zero-coverage gate + D3 [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:406-410, :551, :681-682]: an empty base (or one whose every geometry is discarded) FAILs and stops the step before any overlay. value = the rows the base write carries (feature_count - invalid_geometry_skipped at the gate; written.rows_scanned after the write).

expect.reports: cells nulled by the -1 sentinel / out-of-range rule (D9), row kept

why.text: D9 [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:437-439, :455]: an out-of-range numeric cell (Toronto's -1 "not regulated" sentinel) is nulled, the row is kept and counted. Counted per cell by compute.shapeRecord (tag out_of_range_nulled).

expect.violation_when: base rows share a CKAN _id (every such row is rejected, R2-17)

why.text: R2-17 [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:457-459]: every base row whose _id is not unique is rejected (reject-ALL, deterministic) and the row is FAIL; the layer still loads the unique rows, as legacy did.

why.text: The percentage half of the legacy band [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:481-483]: WARN only while the discarded share is at most the configured percentage, else FAIL. A separate row because one limit carries one bound; the verdict is the legacy one.

expect.of: departed rows over the pre-delete row count (F-H1)

why.text: F-H1 + R2-14 [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:242-248, :544]: value = departed rows x 100 / the pre-delete count (= updated + unchanged + deleted, measured by the write); PASS at or below the warn percentage, WARN at or below the fail percentage, else FAIL. deviations.from: LZ-D14 — legacy followed at most 5 redirects (MAX_REDIRECTS) [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:58, :353-360]

why.text: The library fetch follows up to 20 (every converted INGESTOR; operator D2, 0y O-2). The difference shows only on a 6-20-hop error path CKAN does not produce; the legacy redirect-cap variable is struck from §5 rather than registered with no reader.

why.text: The library arms a whole-request deadline (AbortController) from load_zoning_http_timeout_ms, seeded above 30 s because a full 10,000-record page must arrive inside it (0y §1.6, §3c (iv)).

deviations.from: LZ-D16 — legacy truncated the run clock to whole seconds (`Date.parse(String(runAt))`) [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:585-586]

why.text: The all-primaries gate reads the DB clock with millisecond precision (0y §3c (ii)); the 730-day force window can therefore flip up to one second earlier.

deviations.from: LZ-D18 — geometry validation ran in 1,000-row batches on the pool (BATCH_SIZE) [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:43, :468-478]

why.text: The library validates each layer in ONE read-only statement (write.validateGeometries; LC-D12 precedent). The per-geometry classification is the legacy one: empty-after-extract or a non-simple / zero-length line is discarded, an invalid-but-repairable geometry is repaired.

deviations.from: LZ-D12 (thrown-overlay path) — legacy recorded EVERY layer's new version in zoning_layer_versions, including an overlay whose fetch or load threw [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:698]

On the THROWN path the library surfaces no version for a failed primary, so the compute writes null and the next run reloads that overlay — the ④d fix lands early on that path only.

deviations.from: LZ-D6 — a package_show failure pushed an INFO skip_check_error row that claimed "proceed", then bound String(runAt) as the version and failed on the base upsert [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:603-607]

why.text: Outcome parity, honest message (0y D3, ④a retired): a package_show 5xx or success:false throws by name before any datastore_search GET; the step FAILs with 0 rows written.

deviations.from: LZ-D19 — a base failure pushed FAIL rows (zoning_areas_fetch_error / _load_error, zoning_partial_load) but threw before emitSummary, so the failed run carried no audit_table [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:650-657, :670-672]

why.text: The base primary declares no on_failure (abort_step): its throw fails the step through the runner's failure terminal (failed_step_error). The FAIL path changes shape only; it is absent from the goldens.

why.text: The <layer>_unchanged_skipped rows read the write's MEASURED no-op count (written.unchanged) and row conservation holds per layer (WF2 simplification item 8).

deviations.from: the audit row set — legacy pushed conditional rows only when they fired, scored passing non-INFO rows INFO, and attached _no_baseline / _truncated_class_count / _other_count keys to rows [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:401-575]

why.text: Every declared check emits on every run (heritage LH / ravines LR precedent): conditional per-layer rows (attr drift extras, non-integer _id, null geometry, overlay duplicates, orphan-delete skips) are one aggregate row each with per-layer detail; the ten <layer>_duration_ms rows are one run-level zoning_duration_ms; a passing bounded row reads PASS; no-baseline rows read INFO with a null detail; the distribution truncation counters ride the context row zoning_areas_distribution_top20_truncation. An overlay that throws lands the library row primary_failed:<id> (WARN) in place of <layer>_fetch_error / _fetch_skipped / _load_error.

deviations.from: the base empty / all-discarded path — legacy threw on an empty base before any overlay but, when every base geometry was discarded, wrote nothing to the base, FAILed the row and still loaded the overlays [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:406-410, :551, :681-682]

why.text: zoning_areas_loaded_count is a pre_write gate, so both cases stop at the base and no overlay is acquired (stricter on the all-discarded path; 0 base geometries have been discarded on record).

deviations.from: the zn_zone distribution — legacy counted the INSERTABLE base rows (after dedupe and geometry validation) [READ src/tests/steps/load_zoning/fixtures/legacy-load-zoning.js.txt:563]

why.text: The compute counts the SHAPED base rows (before the reject-all dedupe and the validator), because the runner hands compute counters, not rows. Identical whenever no base row is a duplicate or discarded (0 and 0 on run 1085).

limitations.what: LZ-D2 — source_dataset_version is written by every upsert but is NOT a guard column (H5), so an unchanged row keeps the version stamp of the load that last changed it.
limitations.measured: by design since H5; enrich_parcels' incremental scope compares changed rows only [READ scripts/lib/compute/enrich-parcels.js:207-210]

limitations.what: LZ-D3 — attribute drift is read from the FIRST raw record of each layer only (acquired.record_fields); a later record missing a mapped field loads with that cell NULL.
limitations.measured: CKAN DataStore records carry the full field set on every record (0 drift on record)

limitations.what: LZ-D4 — datastore_search pages by offset with no sort; the order is CKAN's default (ORDER BY _id in practice).
limitations.measured: 1-2 pages per layer at page size 10000 (largest layer 11,719 records)

limitations.what: LZ-D7 — every baseline (loaded_pct, with_exceptions, null counts, duration) reads the latest successful run, which after a skip run carries none of those rows, so the first load after a skip has no baseline (INFO).
limitations.measured: every recorded sources:load_zoning run since 1291 is a skip

limitations.what: LZ-D8 — the 730-day force window and dataset_version_age_days run from the PUBLISHER's version, so after 2028-02-20 every run force-reloads and the age row FAILs until the City republishes.
LZ-D20 — a failed prior-run read degrades to a first run (no skip, no baselines); warn_row makes it a WARN row instead of a log line.

recovery.reset: TRUNCATE is never correct here — re-run with ZONING_FORCE_RELOAD=1, which bypasses the all-layers gate and rewrites every layer through the same guarded upsert plus departure delete.

interrupted_why.text: Ten per-layer transactions commit one after another, so a kill between two leaves some layers on the new version and some on the old while no completed row records the run. Declaring force_full_on_next_run makes the all-primaries gate (detectInterruptedRetraction, 0y GR-4) force the next run to LOAD every layer instead of skipping on the older completed row.

before_image_why.text: Every target declares scope "none" with retract "departed": there is no scoped retraction to mirror, and every column is re-derived from CKAN on a forced reload.

why.text: Every layer was acquired and written (or, for an empty overlay, carried no rows) and every check passed.

A WARN check tripped with no FAIL: an unparseable height label, an overlay that failed or drift-skipped (primary_failed / zoning_overlay_attr_drift), a standing force override, a WARN-band age, or a loaded_pct / orphan WARN band.

R2-12: package_show reports every one of the ten resources unchanged against zoning_layer_versions and the 730-day window has not elapsed, so nothing is fetched; the prior run's five §9 keys are re-emitted so enrich_parcels still finds zoning_layers_loaded on the latest completed row.

A FAIL check tripped: an empty or drifted base (pre_write, nothing written, no overlay acquired), a base duplicate or invalid-polygon band, a loaded_pct or orphan FAIL band, or a dataset older than the fail days.

A step-level throw: package_show failed (LZ-D6), the base layer's fetch or write threw (D3 abort_step), the once-per-step write-privilege preflight failed, or a row-conservation mismatch. Nothing further is written.
Advisory lock 58 is held by another process. Legacy returned with no summary (the SDK SKIP carried no audit_table); the library emits a row-derived SKIP summary.
